acceptance.clause: the clamp is gone and a negative difference renders as a named conflict, proven by violation
acceptance.evidence: session_summary_bastrop leg, authenticated as a Bastrop admin over all 290,077 FY2026 rows: before totalOutstanding 0 with collectionRate 150 (and at least one department clamped to 0 the same way); after totalOutstanding -87,700,895.05 with arithmeticConflict.code 'collected_exceeds_charged' and surplusOverCharged 87,700,895.05; divergence DIVERGENT -> AGREE against the platform route

proven at the route level, NOT on the deployed surface, and the limit is stated: requireResolvedRequestTenantId returns a named 500 tenant_unresolved and the caller returns before any SQL (tests/api/finance-honesty.test.ts). On the deployed app the trigger state is unreachable: the app.use('/api') gate answers 401 to an unauthenticated caller before any finance handler runs (measured, session_summary_anonymous leg), and every caller that passes is bound by team membership or by requireTenant's demo fallback. No request can present a missing binding, so the refusal is a latent guard. The lane did not stage a violation it could not produce.

findings.read: tenant 1 is slug 'your-city' (the DEMO tenant) and holds ZERO mygov_fees rows; all 311,736 belong to tenant 2
findings.so: the old `|| 1` default would have answered as the demo city, not exposed another city's fees. From `(req as any).tenantId || 1` and measured on the live store.

findings.read: the HAVING clause keeps only permits whose charges exceed their collections, and the route silently drops the rest — the permit-level form of the direction the summary route's clamp fabricated into. It is reported, not changed: the list is a 'who owes money' worklist and counting the excluded rows needs a second query this lane did not add.

findings.what: the 'staging' smartcity-os database is the production one
findings.read: smartcity-staging-DATABASE_URL and smartcity-DATABASE_URL resolve to the same Neon endpoint (ep-floral-sound-afocvkct) with the same 311,736 rows
findings.so: there is no separate non-production store for this repo; the UAT app therefore reads the same data as production, which is stated rather than presented as a clean separation.
